findings.finding: The July set is a third-party dashboard export of 533 registry rows, not our observation. All dashboard and Haiku labels in it are UPSTREAM.
Live census 2026-10-27: 23 API-live, 510 API-gone. Both independent censuses agree exactly on API status.
No prior verdict changes: July-7 NO CHANGE, GemStuffer/JFrog NO CHANGE, Andrey78 mass-shape-only, agent activity UNPROVEN, JFrog-only overlap stands with caution.

Survivors split 18 legit / 3 probe / 2 test-named. 13 gems have dated post-July releases (maintenance OBSERVED); 10 have none (availability only). Classification rests on name plus summary self-description; minitest-hashdiff and testgem-mini are UNCERTAIN close calls.

testgem-mini reclassified test-named, use UNEXPLAINED: 5 versions in 5 minutes on July 7, downloads spread evenly across versions, zero reverse dependents. Burst plus even spread plus zero dependents point away from organic use; mechanism unexplained.

Families: combinatorial mass-generation 310 (strict 10x10x10 product, one day per batch), probe/test family 203 (all July 7), small-author ordinary gems 20. The 203/20 split rests on manual judgement and is graded OBSERVED-shape-plus-judgement.

Apex count corrected: 115 names contain substring apex (114 prefixed). Family-B non-placeholder summaries 117 is a residual (203 minus 86), not a positive probe-signal count. Prior 105 is irreproducible; prior partition leaves a 33-row hole.
Apex taxonomy (single label per family-B row): SSRF/internal 66, generic placeholder 55, parser/page 36, registry abuse 34, exfil canary 6, self-asserted authorization/impact 3, webhook-only 3.

Live apex gems are empty shells: apex-oidc-probe 0.1.1 is one 7-byte comment file; apex-blk-test-final 0.0.1 is one 43-byte empty module. For pulled gems the payload lives in metadata, not code. Yanked remainder inferred, not proven.
Three self-asserted authorization claims (2 assessment/proof-of-impact, 1 scope-escalated key push) are OBSERVED as self-description and UNPROVEN as authorization. No key value is present.
apex-hijack-probe-a1 is a separate probe family (author audit, 2026-07-07), not part of the tester batch. v2 apex total is 116 (115 CSV names plus hijack-probe-a1).

Payload union corrected: 83 scan-set rows (29 OAST, 19 webhook, 25 SSRF-shape, 10 XSS, 4 SSTI, minus 4-row OAST/XSS overlap), 85 including author field. SSRF-shape split: 14 internal link-field, 10 public-IP homepages, 1 summary-text row.

No real secrets in the file: service-prefix, key=value, and bearer shapes all 0. Token/checksum wording on 7 summary rows is words about tokens, not tokens. One FAKE_-prefixed shape is synthetic by construction.

Shell phenomenon: all 533 RubyGems pages render 200 including all 510 gone names. Among tombstoned gems, Diffend labelled stub 509, labelled gone 1, functional no-diff 510, redirect-status 28. Page status proves nothing; API status is the authority.

Single true live mirror: klondikemarlen-jira-api repo lives because it is also the live sibling marlens-jira-api's source. Repo live does not prove the dead gem's code recoverable; recovery needs a matching tag/commit/tree check, not done.
Two OAST collectors answer 200 for API-404 gems. A live listener is not a callback receipt, not exfiltration, not a QA verdict. Callback question graded UNRESOLVED; endpoints must not be re-polled.

Ship-time artifact URLs: 49 unique (23 RubyGems pages, 19 Diffend pages, 7 unique live repos). The 19th Diffend page is jrjackson, backfilled since the census (live drift, not census error). Per-gem entries on the reconciled artifact_urls field: 50 live-only, 51 all rows.

Recommendation (a): admit the 310 combinatorial rows as a shape-only lane carrying names, grammar, timing, and dates ONLY, source/homepage fields stripped or flagged pattern-derived; grade string inside each record. Admit the 20 small-author names on their own terms or state the shape-only criterion explicitly.

Recommendation (b): pkg-review-2 re-run is CONDITIONAL on a concrete severity-reuse decision, scope 513 (464 v1 plus 49 unscored), all label sets preserved, matched-shape check first. Otherwise freeze v1 as UPSTREAM with the calibration warning.

Recommendation (c): callback question UNRESOLVED; claim neither QA nor exfiltration. Settling receipt is a per-token operator log entry (time, source, path, headers/body). Recommendation (d): 13 missing July-7 gems are an open scope question; confirming check is a local comparison table fitting all 13.

Deleted gap: '66 unchecked tombstoned source URIs' is false. 65 of the 66 labelled rows have no URI; 1 is deliberately excluded (internal metadata address). Tombstoned source URIs checked 196 of 196 present. Re-ranked gaps: (1) yanked gem code, (2) withdrawn-vs-live per-row rule, (3) 49 unscored rows, (4) 327 no-source-URI names.

Verifier verdict SHIP-WITH-FIXES, both blocking fixes applied: SSRF/payload counts corrected (25/83/85) and Diffend refreshed at ship time (jrjackson full). Fresh 30-name sample: API 30/30, Diffend class 30/30. Open quality gate: no second independent adversarial pass re-ran after fixes.
